## Checklist

- [ ] `go test -race ./...` passes and `gofmt -l .` prints nothing.
- [ ] REFERENCE.md covers changes to public API, defaults, config fields, middleware order, log keys, error codes or CLI flags.
- [ ] AGENTS.md "Known gaps" drops a fixed gap or lists a new one.
- [ ] forgo-adapter has a matching pull request if an adapter contract changed.
